text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wow! This yakisoba pan is so freaking
tasty!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You like it? I'm glad to hear that.
Every time I come 
to this shopping district,
I just can't not buy one.

text_block_list.name: Bakery Owner
text_block_list.text:
Nei-chan, you really do love our yakisoba pan,
don't you. 
I'm always glad to see you enjoying our food
so much 
whenever you come in.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on ma'am,
you don't need to hear that from me. 
If anything,
you really should advertise your bread
more!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature! I wanna eat some croquettes! 
The ones from before!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You really like those croquettes, huh. 
Mister, can I get one croquette please?

text_block_list.name: Meat Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Everyone,
would you like a menchi-katsu as well? 
Nature is always buying those for dinner
and it's the pride of 
our shop!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Woah, that looks so good! I'll take one!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This shopping district feels quite
homely. 
The people here are also very kind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if I were to describe this place, 
it would be tender and amiable.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored to hear you say that. 
To me, this place is like my backyard.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If Turbo sees the arcade as a place to get
energized, 
I see this shopping district as a place
where I 
can take it easy. Or how do I put it…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like after I'm able to gather my mind here,
I feel like I can be 
all like "alright,
let's go for it!" and run well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I like it.
This is your "high-spirit spot" then.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha… I feel kind of embarrassed saying
it out loud…

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmm… Well, I got a good chance to get a 
feel for this place. Guess I'm up next.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright, we're here.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is just your normal riverside! 
C.B., this is your "high-spirit spot?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yup. I'm thinking here today. Feel it? 
The wind,
the color of the sky.
It all feels incredible.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look up to the sky.
Like the encroaching red sunset, 
you want to move faster than the wind.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And from there,
you get the desire to run just like it. 
And before you know it, the sun is setting,
and you stop.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And all you can think about is the desire
to race. 
At least,
that's what I enjoy about this place.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's deep.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
yeah! That's pretty cool! Let's see.
I can't 
really put it in words, but… yeah,
I get you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm sure that is part of our
instinct. 
That is what moves us forward.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well,
that's it for me.
Let's go on to our last spot.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wow! We're so high up!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Feels great,
right!?
The view up here is always the best!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ace!
Is that place over there Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you got good eyes,
Turbo! That's right. Here, you can 
get a good view of everything around the
school!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If I just stay at the school,
I am only seeing a 
small part of the world.
Being up here reminds me 
that the sky is much wider than I can
imagine.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That makes me excited to think about.
Just thinking 
about it makes my dream feel red hot!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What exactly is your dream, Ace?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hmm!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I only dream about one thing!
All that talk about 
common sense and tall hurdles to cross!
I want to 
become the one to tear them all down!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I won't be afraid of anyone that I'm up
against!! 
I won't run away from any race!
I want to prove 
to everyone that nothing is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The "Ace" of the horsegirl world! 
That is who I dream to be!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Turbo! Nature! Rudolf! C.B.!
All of you and the rest of the world! 
One day I'll be the one to take you all
down!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
After all,
"Katsuragi Ace" is standing proud right
here!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wow, wow,
wow! I'm getting really into this too! 
For me,
my legs are the "turbo" that carry me
forth!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha.
It seems that we all view the scenery a bit
differently. Still,
continuously looking forward doesn't seem
so bad.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems that one day I will come to face
that burning passion 
of yours. I'm excited for when that day comes,
Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hahhhhh! Anyways, today was really fun!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Today was a meaningful experience.
Today we all 
presented our own unique locations,
but the core element 
of each was the same.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In other words:
"I wish to run with all I got tomorrow." 
It is that way of thinking that brings forth
the emotions we have.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And that will be the "student body's
high-spirited place," 
I'm guessing.
You know what you will do for the
pamphlet?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Next,
I need to determine the guidelines.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
Rudolf.
Didn't you get one part of that wrong?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's not "tomorrow," it's supposed to be
"now," isn't it?! 
That being said,
let's run back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Me too,
me too! Let's all run back together!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, aren't you two getting too into
this…?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ha ha, sure, why not!? Sounds fun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well,
well.
Aren't you all just overflowing with
energy.

text_block_list.name: Academy Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Woah!
I heard that to create the student pamphlet,
the student 
council is looking for submissions directly
from the students! 
Maybe they'll take some of the photos we
took!

text_block_list.name: Academy Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it rare for the student council to be
asking the 
students for something like this? Oh,
it looks like they're 
looking for videos too.
Maybe I'll help out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm… Well, isn't this is something…
